results.summary_before: This project is a standalone TinyQV I2C controller device that also exposes SPI signals and interrupt outputs. The pin functions are configurable through a CMUX register, and testing may require an NPN transistor and external pull-up resistors on the I2C bus lines. The documentation is incomplete, with a TODO and vague testing instructions, so the exact behavior and configuration are not fully described. It is intended to interface with external I2C and SPI peripherals, possibly using an RP2040.
